feature_definition: RATIO_ENTR_DET = ENTR / %DET. ENTR = -sum p(l)*ln(p(l)) over qualifying diagonal lines l>=l_min=2 (main diagonal excluded, k!=0), p(l)=n(l)/N, natural log raw (C130-consistent). %DET = (sum of diagonal-line points for qualifying diagonal lines l>=l_min=2, main diagonal excluded) / (offdiag recurrence sum). Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if %DET<=0, no qualifying diagonal lines (N==0), ENTR undefined/non-finite, offdiag/recurrence degenerate, or undefined.
